steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: Baa, Chief... Wake up...

steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: Wakey-wakey!

Before your eyes, an old light bulb hangs precariously from the ceiling, its cool light flickering, making you a bit dazed. You try to sit up, but your limbs feel weird. A tingling, soft, and light feeling spreads throughout your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is...
You're still a bit dizzy, but falling unconscious is nothing new to you anymore. You quickly calm down and manage to figure out how to apply strength, turning your head tentatively.
What you see is a huge blackface sheep sticking its muzzle to your nose. Its dull pupils are staring intently at you. You start at the sight.
You instinctively release the spikes and quickly distance yourself from it. But to your surprise, you feel a familiar sensation at the end of the shackles. A connection unique to that with a Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're... Pepper?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Yes, it's me! Sob... Thank goodness you're not hurt, Chief!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: ...If you came here for me, I will feel guilty for the rest of my life!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: I've become a guilty little wooden sheep! I will never be happy again!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Wahhh... Pepper doesn't want to be a sad villain!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: If I'd known, I would have just stayed home and tended to my crops... Sob...
The familiar voice makes you sigh in relief, but it's indeed also noisy enough to start another headache.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Easy there, I'm fine, and I'll take you back. What turned you into that?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Into... a giant sheep?
The little sheep looks you up and down, then hangs her head guiltily as if she's done something wrong.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief, it's not that I've grown in size, it's that we've both shrunk...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you mean?
An ominous feeling makes you anxious suddenly.

You quickly struggle to regain control of your limbs and lift your head slightly clumsily. The rusty door you could easily push open is now towering and unreachable, seeming even more massive than the skyscrapers of Eastside... Are you hallucinating due to the blackout?
Pepper notices your gaze toward the exit.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: You can't open it. I've been trying to push it with all my farming strength for the whole day. But the strength of a <color=#fb9259>toy</color> is just too little... Baa.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A toy?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Yes, Chief.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Once past midnight, anyone who steps into this factory will turn into a toy.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: We... have become toys.
You look down at yourself somewhat belatedly. Your cotton palms are fraying a bit, and your legs are stout and short. With that realization, your cotton brain seems to become a blank too.
Before you can fully process that, the eerie scene before your eyes shocks you anew.

steps.speaker: Blue Soldiers
steps.content: Heave-ho, heave-ho, keep it up!
The toys scattered on the ground get up one by one to stand by the conveyor belt, waving their arms stiffly at nothing.

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier A
steps.content: I'll take care of the assembly!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier B
steps.content: I'll handle the painting!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier C
steps.content: I'll do the final check and packaging!

In the workshop, dusty instruments turn on its red lights. The old machines struggle to operate, trembling incessantly, the sound of rusty metal colliding unsettling. Your surroundings are filled with the smell of motor oil and an uncanny atmosphere.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These are...

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: People who came to this factory before me. Like us, they were turned into toys too.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: They work at night here. You're about to see the factory in its element.

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier A
steps.content: Work hard!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier B
steps.content: To give to the kids!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier C
steps.content: A sweet dream!
Plastic limbs collide with each other, echoing the well-coordinated yet eerie chant.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: This place will gradually transform everyone into toys.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Your body will become stiffer day by day until it is completely out of your control and you lose your rational mind! Then, you'll be motionless during the day and turn into dumdums like them at night.

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier A
steps.content: Screws!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier B
steps.content: Wrench!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier C
steps.content: Drill!
The plastic dolls repeat their tasks mechanically, already a part of this factory.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... we will also become a part of the factory and completely lose our self-awareness and control over our bodies. I'm afraid it'll be impossible for us to escape if we just sit and wait until then.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: In fact, you don't even need to wait that long... I've been here for a whole day now...

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Toyification is a faster process than you can imagine... Baa.
Pepper stands up and smiles a bit ruefully. You see that her movements are already going out of control, stiff like her body is wearing out and breaking down. Just like a real wooden toy.
